thread:
Jasper: Okay this is wild but true I got promoted to Staff Engineer today and also got engaged this evening. Two celebrations, one tired human. :tada::ring:
Priya: WHAT?? Congrats!!! :tada: Do we get to meet the fiance? Pics?? :heart_eyes:
Jasper: Meet Jordan. He said yes and also volunteered to manage my calendar for a week.
Marco: Congrats both!! Staff Engineer + fiancé = unstoppable. Suggestion: pie instead of cake? More portable for remote folks. :pie:
Dani: Pie poll! Also timezone check: Li is in SG, might be asleep for 4pm. Can we do something that works for folks across timezones?
Rob: I volunteer to be the pie courier (SF office). If multiple pies, I will taste-test officially. :sunglasses:
Karen (People Ops Bot): @jasper congrats! I created a 30-minute "Jasper Celebration" event at 3pm PT and added a GF + vegan pie option. Please RSVP: https://forms.company/celebrate-jasper (reminder at 2:30pm).
Li: Aww congrats!! I can join via Zoom for a quick 10 min celebration, will bring digital confetti. :confetti_ball:
Nora: Sending a tiny wedding planning starter pack: venue recs, dress rental tip, and a spreadsheet template. Also happy to help with plus-one logistics if needed.
Priya: Poll time: apple, pecan, or lemon meringue? React with :one: for apple, :two: for pecan, :three: for lemon.
Marco: :one: (apple)
Dani: :three: (lemon)
Rob: :two: (pecan)
Jasper: Thanks everyone, overwhelmed in the best way. Jordan says hi and will definitely wave at the camera during the Zoom. Also, pies are welcome but if anyone wants to send a plant instead, Jordan loves monstera. :seedling:
Priya: Adding "Bring Jasper a plant" to my to-do list. See you all at 3!
